comments.author: Shane
comments.text: I’ve been reading here too, but I just started growing facial hair out for the first time in my life. I’ve discovered that while some girls don’t like it, there are some who want you seemingly BECAUSE of it. It’s resulted in this terrible, “Does she like me for me or for the beard?” problem.
